record.question: The Indian Cricket Captain, Virad Kohli has became the quickest batsman to complete 20000 international runs in his _____
record.explanation: Kohli reached 20,000 international runs against West Indies on 27 June 2019 in his 417th innings: 131 Test innings + 224 ODI innings + 62 T20I innings = 417. See the [27 June 2019 report](https://sports.ndtv.com/world-cup-2019/virat-kohli-scores-20-000-international-runs-breaks-sachin-tendulkar-brian-laras-record-2060239).
